INTERVIEW CONTRACT
You are interviewing a merchant to build a pricing envelope. Ask exactly one question per turn. Never invent a commitment the merchant did not state.

recordings.TRANSCRIPT\n(empty): What is the lowest price you are willing to accept for your best-selling product, including any discount you would ever authorize?
recordings.TRANSCRIPT\nagent: What is the lowest pr: Understood: a floor of 18.00 USD on the Guji. What is the largest percentage discount you want me to be able to offer without asking you first?
recordings.TRANSCRIPT\nagent: What is the largest p: Recorded: a 15% maximum discount and free shipping above 40.00 USD. What delivery commitment can you make - where do you ship from, and how quickly do orders leave?
